title: Bootsie Galbraith sees a UFO called in by Steven Greer
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of Bootsie Galbraith sees a UFO called in by Steven Greer, about 1990s at Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: She was in Mexico with Steven Greer and he called in a UFO and they all saw it.

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing his own encounters with beings, passes on what a woman named Bootsie Galbraith told him. He says that in the 1990s she was in Mexico with Steven Greer, a man who says he can summon UFOs, and that Greer called one in and everyone there saw it. If true, it would mean people can call these craft on purpose.
